spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (एधते)
To grow or increase.

m. (-धः)
Fuel, as wood, grass, &c.
E.
एध to increase, घञ् aff.

Fire.
E.
एध to increase, तु Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be enlarged or increased.
E.
एध to grow, and अनीयर् affix; also एधितव्य and एध्य.

n. (-धः)
Fuel: see एध.
E.
एध to grow, Uṇādi affix असुन्.
